integrity: Complete source code, exact enumerations, edge certificates, and execution output are included; certificate enumeration covers all subsets and all one-token moves.
scientific_limitations: Finite, exhaustive certificate for the sixteen-vertex graph GP(8,3), not a uniform theorem on all generalized Petersen graphs. Prior published census of its 584 minimum identifying codes is explicitly excluded from originality. Unindexed duplicate mobility computations and independent scholarly review remain possible; no independently audited priority is asserted.
title: Frozen and mobile minimum identifying codes of the Möbius–Kantor graph
